'''Orawn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the rank as [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. He and his men were dispatched to reclaim a captured [[Dorn Base power station|Imperial power station]] from Talz forces.
